policy: Explicit mappings only. A lab model is never silently matched to a similar name. A proxy is a documented best guess: it produces an estimate labelled with its review status and CLEER confidence, and it is never described as measured. Edit this file to add or change a mapping; nothing else may substitute a model.

models.rationale: CLEER publishes Claude Sonnet 5 but not Claude Sonnet 5.5. The current point release is used as an explicit proxy; it is not an exact match and the estimate is inferred. Review and record a decision before treating the figure as settled.

CLEER publishes Claude Opus 5 but not Claude Opus 5.5. The current point release is used as an explicit proxy; it is not an exact match and the estimate is inferred. CLEER's own confidence for Claude Opus 5 is low (0.467), so treat the figure as an order of magnitude.
